lore: Some say the dead keep a ledger. This shrine is where it is kept, and its soul flame never forgets a name.
use: Open it to see where the items of your last death went: still lying (with a despawn bar), picked up by you or someone else, burned, despawned, fallen into the void or gone another way - each in its own color, with a legend beside the list.
secret: A paused bar means the chunk is not loaded and the timer stands. Soulbound items never appear: they never left you.

lore: A tradesman's manual for gear that should outlast its owner.
use: The Simple Tools Guide explains the lava-filled furnace, durability bonuses, Soulbound and the Death Vault. Craft it shapeless from a book and an anvil.
secret: Its pages open in your language and nothing is consumed.

lore: Paint the land itself. The heart in the ferrule remembers every place it has seen.
use: Hold it in the main hand and a biome material in the off hand, then right-click a block: sand paints desert, snow paints snowy plains, soul sand paints a soul sand valley. One material and one durability point per stroke.
secret: Biomes stay in their dimension, and claimed land or caves cannot be painted. Unbreaking and Mending work on it.
